WITH top_customer AS (
    SELECT T1."XCL_001" AS customer_id
    FROM customers AS T1
    INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1."XCL_001" = T2."XCL_019"
    WHERE T1."XCL_003" = 'EUR'
      AND T2."XCL_020" LIKE '2012%'
    GROUP BY T1."XCL_001"
    ORDER BY SUM(T2."XCL_021") DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
consumption AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(CASE WHEN T2."XCL_020" LIKE '2012%' THEN T2."XCL_021" ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2012,
        SUM(CASE WHEN T2."XCL_020" LIKE '2013%' THEN T2."XCL_021" ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2013
    FROM yearmonth AS T2
    WHERE T2."XCL_019" = (SELECT customer_id FROM top_customer)
),
discount_stations AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(CASE WHEN "XCL_006" = 'CZE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cz_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN "XCL_006" = 'SVK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sk_count
    FROM gasstations
    WHERE "XCL_007" = 'Discount'
)
SELECT
    (SELECT customer_id FROM top_customer) AS customer_id,
    CAST((c.consumption_2013 - c.consumption_2012) AS REAL) * 100 / c.consumption_2012 AS percentage_change,
    (ds.cz_count - ds.sk_count) AS discount_station_difference
FROM consumption AS c
CROSS JOIN discount_stations AS ds
